condition.zh: 術後復健 · 全膝關節置換

tagline.zh: 新膝蓋、一支助行器和一條喊痛的小腿
tagline.en: A new knee, a walker and a calf that aches

desc.zh: 跟著周主治看術後第二天的膝蓋：角度、傷口、小腿，還有一通骨科電話。小腿痛要不要停，決定的人是你。
desc.en: With Dr Chou on a knee two days after surgery: angles, wound, calf, and a call to orthopaedics. Whether a sore calf stops the session is your decision.

desc.zh: 量角器、轉位、助行器與走廊都在你手上；阿雪姨站起來的每一次，你在旁邊。
desc.en: Goniometer, transfers, the walker and the corridor are yours; every time Auntie Hsueh stands up, you are beside her.

about.zh: 腰上永遠掛著計步器。今天的咖啡放在護理站櫃台，一樣沒喝完。
about.en: Always a pedometer on his belt. Today's coffee sits on the station counter, unfinished as ever.

about.zh: 交班一句話講完一個病人，但小腿的事她講了三句。
about.en: Hands over a patient in one sentence, but gave the calf three.

about.zh: 把生活拆成步驟的人。今天拆的是一攤菜：搬、站、蹲、找零。
about.en: Breaks life into steps. Today's life is a vegetable stall: lifting, standing, squatting, making change.

role.en: Day two after right knee replacement

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。七十二歲，菜市場賣了四十年菜，有糖尿病。想在中元節前回到攤位。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Seventy-two, forty years at a market vegetable stall, has diabetes. Wants to be back at the stall before the Ghost Festival.

about.zh: 大學生，手機裡存了二十支復健影片。每一支都想讓阿嬤試。
about.en: A university student with twenty rehab videos on his phone. Wants Grandma to try every one.

about.zh: 顧著攤位，人到不了，訊息一直到。
about.en: Minding the stall, cannot come, messages all day.

about.zh: 電話很短。聽到「小腿腫痛」會自己把超音波排好。
about.en: Short calls. Hears “swollen, painful calf” and books the ultrasound himself.

about.zh: 夜裡打來的事只有兩種：痛，和睡不著。通常是同一件。
about.en: Calls at night for two things: pain, and not sleeping. Usually the same thing.

plain.zh: 把磨壞的膝關節表面換成金屬與塑膠的人工關節。手術是一天，練回來要幾個月。
plain.en: Replacing the worn surfaces of the knee with a metal-and-plastic joint. The operation takes a day; getting it working again takes months.

plain.zh: 關節能彎到、伸到哪裡，用角度表示。術後每天量，看的是趨勢，不是一次的數字。
plain.en: How far a joint bends and straightens, in degrees. Measured daily after surgery; the trend matters more than one number.

plain.zh: 量關節角度的工具，兩支臂對準骨頭的長軸，軸心放在關節轉動的中心。
plain.en: The tool for measuring joint angles: two arms along the long axes of the bones, the pivot over the joint's centre of rotation.

plain.zh: 膝蓋伸不直還差幾度。新膝蓋最怕的不是彎不夠，是伸不直：走路會跛，久了關節更緊。
plain.en: The degrees a knee cannot straighten. A new knee's enemy is not too little bending but incomplete straightening: it causes a limp and a stiffer joint later.

plain.zh: 腿部深層靜脈裡形成血塊。術後躺著不動是最大的風險；小腿腫、痛、發熱要先想到它。
plain.en: A clot forming in a deep leg vein. Lying still after surgery is the biggest risk; a swollen, painful, warm calf should make you think of it first.

plain.zh: 腿上的血塊脫落跑到肺部血管，突然喘、胸痛、心跳快。這是急症，不是復健的問題。
plain.en: A leg clot breaking off and lodging in the lung vessels: sudden breathlessness, chest pain, a racing heart. An emergency, not a rehab problem.

plain.zh: 用超音波看血管裡的血流，壓一壓靜脈看它能不能被壓扁。找深層靜脈栓塞的第一線檢查。
plain.en: Ultrasound that shows blood flow in a vessel and whether the vein squashes flat under the probe. The first-line test for a deep vein clot.

plain.zh: 四隻腳的步行輔具。先放好、先走它，手不要去拉它站起來。
plain.en: The four-legged walking aid. Place it first, step it first, and never pull on it to stand up.

term.zh: 好腳上天堂、壞腳下地獄
term.en: up with the good, down with the bad

plain.zh: 上樓梯好腳先上，下樓梯開刀的腳先下；拐杖永遠跟著開刀的腳。
plain.en: Going upstairs lead with the good leg; going down lead with the operated leg; the crutch always travels with the operated leg.

plain.zh: 血糖掉太低：冒汗、手抖、心慌、發呆。糖尿病人沒吃飯又運動，就容易發生。先坐下，依流程測血糖、給糖。
plain.en: Blood sugar too low: sweating, shaking, palpitations, going blank. Skipped meals plus exercise in a person with diabetes is the classic set-up. Sit them down, check and give sugar per protocol.

plain.zh: 術後用冰袋隔著布敷腫脹的關節，一次一段時間就要拿開，看皮膚。
plain.en: A cold pack wrapped in cloth on the swollen joint after surgery; remove it after a while and check the skin.

plain.zh: 打電話回報的固定順序：身分、情境、背景、評估、建議，最後複誦。
plain.en: The fixed order for a call: Identity, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation, then read back.

text.zh: 軸心對準膝關節外側的轉動中心，一臂對大腿骨，一臂對小腿骨。伸直也要量，不只量彎曲。
text.en: Pivot over the lateral centre of rotation of the knee, one arm along the thigh bone, one along the shin. Measure extension too, not only flexion.

text.zh: 高度到手腕橫紋。放正前方、先走它、再走開刀的腳、好腳跟上。
text.en: Height to the wrist crease. Place it straight ahead, step it first, then the operated leg, then the good leg.

text.zh: 隔著毛巾、墊高、看時間。冰敷消腫止痛，但冰不掉一條栓塞的靜脈。
text.en: Through a towel, leg elevated, watch the clock. Ice reduces swelling and pain, but it cannot cool away a clotted vein.

text.zh: 床號、術後第幾天、今天目標、誰被通知。小腿的事寫在最上面。
text.en: Bed, post-op day, today's goal, who was told. The calf goes at the top.

text.zh: 術後 X 光看人工關節的位置，超音波看靜脈。兩張圖回答兩個不同的問題。
text.en: The post-op X-ray shows the implant's position; the ultrasound shows the vein. Two pictures answering two different questions.

name.en: A red rubber band from the stall

text.zh: 阿雪姨綁在你筆上的。「免得你弄丟。攤位上我都這樣綁。」
text.en: Auntie Hsueh tied it round your pen. “So you don't lose it. That's how I do it at the stall.”

name.en: Red flags in a post-op calf

text.zh: 術後小腿腫、痛、發熱、單側變粗，先想深層靜脈栓塞：停訓練、不按摩、量腿圍、通知手術團隊、安排杜卜勒超音波。突然喘或胸痛，就是肺栓塞的警報，直接走急救流程。臨床症狀不可靠，沒症狀也可能有血塊，所以才需要預防：早活動、依醫囑抗凝、彈性襪。
text.en: A swollen, painful, warm or thicker calf after surgery means think deep vein thrombosis first: stop the session, do not massage, measure the calf, tell the surgical team, book a duplex ultrasound. Sudden breathlessness or chest pain is the alarm for pulmonary embolism and goes straight to the emergency pathway. Symptoms are unreliable and a clot may be silent, which is why prevention exists: early mobilisation, anticoagulation per order, compression stockings.

text.zh: 關節活動度是能力，回到攤位是參與。攤位需要的是：凌晨站四小時、搬菜籃、蹲下找零、踩濕地板。復健目標寫成地點與動作，而不是度數，團隊才知道還缺什麼：椅凳、防滑鞋、分段休息、家人分工。
text.en: Range of motion is capacity; being back at the stall is participation. The stall demands four hours standing before dawn, lifting crates, squatting for change, a wet floor. Write the goal as a place and an action rather than a number of degrees, and the team can see what is still missing: a stool, non-slip shoes, planned rests, family sharing the load.

text.zh: 糖尿病病人運動前先問：吃了嗎、打了針或吃了藥嗎、上次血糖多少。檢查一拖、一餐沒吃，走廊走到一半就會冒汗發抖。處理順序永遠是：先坐下、依流程測血糖、能吞就給糖、通知護理師與醫師、記錄並找原因。預防比處理便宜：訓練時間避開空腹，口袋裡放糖。
text.en: Before a person with diabetes exercises, ask: have you eaten, have you had your insulin or tablets, what was the last sugar. One delayed test and one skipped meal, and they are sweating and shaking halfway down the corridor. The order is always: sit down, check the sugar per protocol, give sugar if they can swallow, tell the nurse and doctor, record it and find the cause. Prevention is cheaper: train away from empty stomachs and keep sugar in a pocket.

note.zh: 交班：術後第二天，小腿有點痛
note.en: Handover: post-op day two, a slightly sore calf

lines.zh: 骨科病房，早上七點半。周主治的咖啡放在護理站櫃台上，計步器已經走了兩千步。
lines.en: The orthopaedic ward, half past seven. Dr Chou's coffee is on the station counter; his pedometer already says two thousand.

lines.zh: 3 床阿雪姨，右膝全膝關節置換術後第二天，引流管昨天拔了，止痛依醫囑。
lines.en: Bed 3, Auntie Hsueh, day two after a right total knee replacement. Drain out yesterday, analgesia per order.

lines.zh: 昨天第一次站有點暈。還有，她說右小腿有點痛。我講三次了，小腿。
lines.en: A bit dizzy on her first stand yesterday. And she says her right calf is a little sore. That's the third time I've said calf.

lines.zh: 聽到了。術後第二天的小腿痛，你們先想什麼？
lines.en: Heard. A sore calf on day two: what do you think of first?

lines.zh: 深層靜脈栓塞。先看再練。
lines.en: Deep vein thrombosis. Look before we train.

guide.en: Read the message at the station

sub.zh: 媽媽說小腿痛，是正常的嗎？
sub.en: Mum says her calf hurts. Is that normal?

lines.zh: 我在顧攤位走不開。媽媽說小腿痛，是正常的嗎？要不要幫她按一按？
lines.en: I'm stuck at the stall. Mum says her calf hurts. Is that normal? Should someone rub it for her?

lines.zh: 先不要按。我們早上會檢查，看完再回您。
lines.en: Please don't rub it. We'll examine it this morning and message you after.

lines.zh: 回得好。小腿有血塊的時候，按摩是最糟的主意。
lines.en: Good answer. When a calf might hold a clot, massage is the worst idea going.

lines.zh: 醫生，我這個膝蓋什麼時候可以蹲？中元節前我要回攤位。
lines.en: Doctor, when can this knee squat? I need to be back at the stall before the Ghost Festival.

lines.zh: 阿嬤，影片說第三天就可以練蹲了。
lines.en: Grandma, the video says you can squat on day three.

lines.zh: 影片沒看過你阿嬤的膝蓋。我們先量。
lines.en: The video has never seen your grandmother's knee. We measure first.

lines.zh: 阿雪姨，先讓我看看小腿，再量角度。
lines.en: Auntie Hsueh, let me look at the calf first, then the angles.

lines.zh: 量角器。軸心、兩支臂。彎曲量完，伸直也要量。
lines.en: Goniometer. Pivot, two arms. After flexion, measure extension too.

lines.zh: 伸直不足最容易被忘記。
lines.en: The extension deficit is the one everyone forgets.

post.zh: 數字寫在交班板，明天同一個人、同一個姿勢再量。看趨勢。
post.en: Numbers on the board; tomorrow the same person, same position, again. We watch the trend.

lines.zh: 右小腿比左邊粗一點，摸起來溫溫的，她皺了一下眉。
lines.en: The right calf is a little thicker than the left and warm to the touch. She winces.

lines.zh: 痠痠的而已啦，昨天走太多。
lines.en: Just achy. I walked too much yesterday.

q.zh: 小腿腫、溫、單側。今天的訓練怎麼辦？
q.en: A swollen, warm, one-sided calf. What happens to today's session?

options.zh: 暫停下肢訓練，量腿圍，通知骨科
options.en: Hold leg training, measure the calf, call orthopaedics

why.zh: 先排除深層靜脈栓塞。停下來的那一節課，比練下去便宜太多。
why.en: Rule out deep vein thrombosis first. One lost session is far cheaper than training on a clot.

options.zh: 術後痠痛很正常，照原計畫練
options.en: Normal post-op soreness, train as planned

why.zh: 「正常」是排除之後才能說的話。
why.en: “Normal” is a word you earn after ruling things out.

options.zh: 請孫子幫她按摩小腿放鬆
options.en: Ask her grandson to massage the calf

why.zh: 若有血塊，按摩可能把它推向肺部。
why.en: If a clot is there, massage can send it to the lungs.

post.zh: 腿圍量兩邊、同一個高度、寫下來。然後打電話。
post.en: Calf circumference both sides, same level, written down. Then make the call.

guide.en: Set the goal with Auntie Hsueh

lines.zh: 等超音波的時間，談目標。這題寫的是中風病人，但問題一模一樣：走得更遠，還需要什麼？
lines.en: While we wait for the ultrasound, the goal. This exercise is written for a stroke patient, but the question is identical: to walk farther, what else matters?

lines.zh: 我的目標很簡單：攤位。凌晨四點、站到八點。
lines.en: My goal is simple: the stall. Four in the morning, standing till eight.

post.zh: 目標要有地點、有動作。「攤位、站四小時、蹲下找零」比「膝蓋彎到一百二」有用。
post.en: A goal has a place and an action. “The stall, four hours standing, squatting for change” beats “bend to one-twenty”.

note.zh: 杜卜勒超音波排除栓塞
note.en: Duplex ultrasound to exclude a clot

sub.zh: 3 床小腿的事，超音波排好了
sub.en: Bed 3's calf: the ultrasound is booked

lines.zh: 3 床小腿，我排了杜卜勒超音波。你用 ISBAR 跟我講一次現在的狀況。
lines.en: Bed 3's calf: I've booked a duplex ultrasound. Give me the current picture in ISBAR.

lines.zh: 3 床阿雪姨，右膝置換術後第二天。情境：右小腿腫、溫、單側痛。背景：糖尿病，昨天首次下床。
lines.en: Bed 3, Auntie Hsueh, day two after right knee replacement. Situation: right calf swollen, warm, painful on one side. Background: diabetes, first out of bed yesterday.

lines.zh: 評估：腿圍右大於左，沒有喘、沒有胸痛。建議：暫停下肢訓練到超音波結果出來。
lines.en: Assessment: right calf larger than left, no breathlessness, no chest pain. Recommendation: hold leg training until the scan is reported.

lines.zh: 複誦：右小腿腫溫痛、無喘無胸痛、暫停訓練等結果。好。
lines.en: Read-back: right calf swollen, warm, painful; no breathlessness or chest pain; training held pending the scan. Good.

lines.zh: 術後片看人工關節的位置，超音波看靜脈。兩張圖，兩個問題。
lines.en: The post-op film shows the implant; the ultrasound shows the vein. Two pictures, two questions.

question.zh: 術後小腿腫痛，第一個要排除什麼？用什麼檢查？
question.en: A swollen, painful calf after surgery: what do you rule out first, and with what?

answer.zh: 深層靜脈栓塞。第一線用杜卜勒超音波：看血流、壓靜脈看能不能壓扁。臨床判斷不可靠，所以要靠影像；一旦突然喘或胸痛，就是肺栓塞的警報，走急救流程。
answer.en: Deep vein thrombosis. First line is duplex ultrasound: look at flow and whether the vein compresses flat. Clinical judgement is unreliable, so imaging decides; sudden breathlessness or chest pain is the alarm for pulmonary embolism and goes to the emergency pathway.

post.zh: 報告回來了：靜脈壓得扁，沒有血塊。這次是肌肉痠痛。
post.en: The report is back: the vein compresses, no clot. This time it was muscle soreness.

lines.zh: 你們停得對。十次停有九次是虛驚，第十次救一條命。
lines.en: You were right to stop. Nine holds out of ten are false alarms; the tenth saves a life.

lines.zh: 下午可以走了。走廊，助行器。
lines.en: She can walk this afternoon. Corridor, walker.

lines.zh: 這次運氣好，沒有血塊。早上那個決定，換一個病人就不是運氣的問題了。
lines.en: Lucky this time: no clot. On another patient, this morning's decision would not have been about luck.

lines.zh: 下次小腿先看、先停、先打電話。
lines.en: Next time: look at the calf, stop, and call, in that order.

note.zh: 助行器走廊；一個冒汗的下午
note.en: Walker in the corridor; a sweaty afternoon

guide.en: Help Auntie Hsueh stand from the bed

lines.zh: 阿雪姨，我們從床邊開始。助行器放前面，手撐床，不要拉助行器。
lines.en: Auntie Hsueh, we start at the bedside. Walker in front, push up from the bed, don't pull on the walker.

lines.zh: 我賣菜四十年，站起來還要人教？
lines.en: Forty years selling vegetables and I need lessons in standing up?

lines.zh: 新膝蓋第一次，什麼都要教一次。
lines.en: First time on a new knee, everything gets taught once.

q.zh: 從床到助行器站立與起步的順序
q.en: From bed to standing and stepping with a walker

steps.zh: 床頭搖高，坐到床緣，雙腳踩地
steps.en: Head up, sit on the edge, feet flat on the floor

steps.zh: 穿防滑鞋，助行器放正前方
steps.en: Non-slip shoes on, walker straight ahead

steps.zh: 雙手撐床面站起，不拉助行器
steps.en: Push up from the bed; never pull the walker
Stand still, count to three, check for dizziness

steps.zh: 助行器先、開刀腳跟上、好腳再跟
steps.en: Walker first, operated leg, then the good leg

post.zh: 好，走廊。我要走到日光室。
post.en: Fine. The corridor. I'm walking to the day room.

guide.en: Walk with her to the day room

lines.zh: 走到一半，阿雪姨停下來。額頭冒汗，手在助行器上抖。
lines.en: Halfway along, Auntie Hsueh stops. Sweat on her forehead, hands trembling on the walker.

lines.zh: 我……怪怪的。心慌。
lines.en: I… feel odd. My heart's racing.

lines.zh: 阿嬤早上為了照超音波沒吃早餐，中午也只吃兩口。
lines.en: Grandma skipped breakfast for the scan and only had two bites of lunch.

options.zh: 扶她坐下，依流程測血糖、給糖，通知護理師
options.en: Sit her down, check and give sugar per protocol, tell the nurse

why.zh: 糖尿病、空腹、運動、冒汗手抖：先坐下，先測血糖。能吞就給糖。
why.en: Diabetes, empty stomach, exercise, sweating and shaking: sit first, check sugar first. If she can swallow, give sugar.

options.zh: 休息一下繼續走，快到了
options.en: Rest a moment and keep walking, nearly there

why.zh: 走到日光室不會讓血糖回來。
why.en: Reaching the day room will not bring the sugar back up.

options.zh: 先量血壓，可能是姿勢性低血壓
options.en: Check the blood pressure first, probably postural

why.zh: 空腹、冒汗、手抖，先想低血糖；血壓可以第二個量。
why.en: Empty stomach, sweating and shaking says low sugar first; blood pressure can be second.

post.zh: 血糖測了，偏低。糖給了，十分鐘後再測。
post.en: Sugar checked, low. Sugar given; we re-check in ten minutes.

post.zh: 訓練前三個問題：吃了嗎、藥打了嗎、上次血糖多少。今天少問了。
post.en: Three questions before training: have you eaten, have you had your medicine, what was the last sugar. Today we skipped them.

post.zh: 攤位上我口袋都有糖果。住院反而忘了。
post.en: At the stall I always have sweets in my pocket. Hospital made me forget.

guide.zh: 到日光室找蔡職能治療師
guide.en: Find Tsai in the day room

lines.zh: 攤位是什麼？凌晨搬菜籃、站四小時、蹲下找零、地板是濕的。我們一項一項拆。
lines.en: What is the stall? Crates before dawn, four hours standing, squatting for change, a wet floor. We take it apart one piece at a time.

lines.zh: 還有跟隔壁攤吵架。
lines.en: And arguing with the stall next door.

lines.zh: 那個不用練。先談疲倦和環境。
lines.en: That one needs no practice. Fatigue and environment first.

post.zh: 高腳凳、防滑鞋、找零的錢盒放腰的高度、兩小時坐十分鐘。寫進目標板。
post.en: A high stool, non-slip shoes, the cash box at waist height, ten minutes seated every two hours. It goes on the goal board.

lines.zh: 我們家攤位後面有三階樓梯。影片說……
lines.en: There are three steps behind our stall. The video says…

lines.zh: 這次我幫影片講：好腳上天堂、壞腳下地獄。哪一句是上樓？
lines.en: Let me speak for the video this time: up with the good, down with the bad. Which half is going upstairs?

options.zh: 好腳先上，拐杖跟著開刀腳
options.en: Good leg up first, crutch stays with the operated leg

why.zh: 上樓好腳出力把身體撐上去；下樓換開刀腳先下，拐杖永遠陪著開刀腳。
why.en: Going up, the good leg lifts the body; going down, the operated leg leads, and the crutch always keeps it company.

options.en: Operated leg first, to build strength

why.zh: 新膝蓋撐不住全身往上，容易跌。
why.en: A new knee cannot lift the whole body up a step; that is how people fall.

post.zh: 好腳上天堂、壞腳下地獄。這個我記得住，跟隔壁攤吵架一樣順口。
post.en: Up with the good, down with the bad. That one I'll remember; it rolls off the tongue like an argument.

lines.zh: 3 床：杜卜勒超音波陰性，下午走廊有低血糖一次，已處理並通知；訓練前要先問吃飯與血糖。
lines.en: Bed 3: duplex ultrasound negative; one hypoglycaemia episode in the corridor this afternoon, treated and reported; ask about meals and sugar before every session.

lines.zh: 小腿的事終於有人寫在最上面了。
lines.en: At last someone has written the calf at the top.

lines.zh: 今天三件事：小腿先看再練；目標要有地點；訓練前先問吃了沒。
lines.en: Three things today: look at the calf before you train; a goal needs a place; ask about food before you start.

lines.zh: 還有，伸直不足要每天量。新膝蓋彎不夠可以慢慢來，伸不直會跟一輩子。
lines.en: And measure the extension deficit every day. A new knee can take its time bending, but a knee that will not straighten stays that way for life.

lines.zh: 他拿起櫃台上的咖啡，看了一眼，放回去。計步器：一萬一千步。
lines.en: He picks up the coffee from the counter, looks at it, puts it back. Pedometer: eleven thousand.

lines.zh: 筆給我。
lines.en: Give me your pen.

lines.zh: 她從口袋掏出一條紅橡皮筋，繞在你的筆上，繞了三圈。
lines.en: She pulls a red rubber band from her pocket and winds it round your pen, three turns.

lines.zh: 免得你弄丟。攤位上我都這樣綁。中元節來買菜，算你便宜。
lines.en: So you don't lose it. That's how I do it at the stall. Come at the Ghost Festival, I'll give you a good price.

note.zh: 夜裡的膝蓋：墊高、冰敷、不要枕頭
note.en: A knee at night: elevate, ice, no pillow under it

sub.zh: 3 床膝蓋痛睡不著，想要墊枕頭
sub.en: Bed 3's knee hurts, can't sleep, wants a pillow under it

lines.zh: 3 床說膝蓋脹痛睡不著，要我拿枕頭墊在膝蓋下面。小腿我摸過，跟下午一樣。
lines.en: Bed 3 says the knee is throbbing and she can't sleep; she wants a pillow under the knee. I've checked the calf: same as this afternoon.

lines.zh: 謝謝你先摸小腿。枕頭墊在腳踝下讓膝蓋伸直，不要墊膝蓋下面；冰敷依流程，止痛依醫囑。
lines.en: Thank you for checking the calf first. Pillow under the ankle so the knee stays straight, never under the knee; ice per protocol, analgesia per order.

lines.zh: 如果她突然喘、胸痛、或小腿變樣，不要等我，直接按急救流程。
lines.en: If she suddenly gets breathless, has chest pain or the calf changes, don't wait for me; go straight to the emergency pathway.

lines.zh: 複誦：腳踝墊高、膝蓋不墊、冰敷依流程、喘或胸痛直接急救流程。
lines.en: Read-back: ankle elevated, nothing under the knee, ice per protocol, breathless or chest pain goes straight to the emergency pathway.

lines.zh: 你放下電話。桌上的筆，紅橡皮筋繞了三圈，還在。
lines.en: You put the phone down. On the desk, the pen with the red rubber band wound three times is still there.

sub.zh: 小腿先看再練；目標要有地點
sub.en: Look at the calf before you train; a goal needs a place
